The shared Reflect tag denotes use of the Realm-owned ordinary %Reflect% global object. It binds only the parent object's identity, prototype, and non-callable/non-constructable surface; exact esid metadata or method-specific feature tags remain authoritative for individual Reflect operations.

This operation-specific tag binds legacy and current pinned scenarios to the exact Reflect.construct algorithm: target/newTarget constructor validation, CreateListFromArrayLike, and Construct. The shared Reflect tag separately supplies the parent object dependency.
